title: Mnara wa Tsutenkaku ulionekana mzuri zaidi tulipouona kwa mara ya kwanza kutoka mbali
label: Tsutenkaku

text.In Osaka, I went to a place called Tsute: Huko Osaka, nilitembelea sehemu inayoitwa Tsutenkaku.
text.It was just the time of the Osaka Expo,: Ilikuwa wakati wa Maonyesho ya Osaka, kwa hiyo Tsutenkaku pia ilikuwa na rangi za Expo.
text.But when I saw it up close, the size fel: Lakini nilipoiona karibu, ukubwa wake ulinifanya nifikirie, “Aha, ndiyo hii.”
text.When I saw Tsutenkaku from far away, I g: Nilifurahi sana nilipouona Tsutenkaku kwa mbali.
text.My mom and I had come to Tsutenkaku by b: Mimi na mama yangu tulikuwa tumefika Tsutenkaku kwa baiskeli,
text.so when we saw Tsutenkaku, my mom and I: kwa hiyo tulifurahi sana sote wawili tulipouona mnara huo.
text.We thought, \"Wow, it is the one we saw: Tulisema, “Lo, ndio ule tuliouona kwenye runinga!” kisha tukakanyaga baiskeli kuelekea karibu nao.
text.But when we got close, my feeling was, \: Lakini tulipokaribia, nilijikuta nikisema, “Aha, kumbe uko hivi.”
Lakini huenda si Tsutenkaku pekee ilivyo hivyo.
text.Maybe it is also true for Tokyo Skytree: Huenda pia ndivyo ilivyo kwa Tokyo Skytree au mnara wa runinga wa Nagoya.
text.Maybe with towers, even when we go up cl: Huenda tunapokaribia minara, sisi binadamu hufikiri, “Aha, kumbe uko hivi.”
text.But when you see it from far away, it is: Lakini ukiuona kwa mbali, unapendeza sana na unasisimua kweli.
